name: Perdelay floor 1 frame
description: skills.txt perdelay values of 1 to 4 are honoured instead of being raised to 5 frames. A blank, 0 or negative perdelay still ticks every 5 frames, as in the stock game. Changes all three copies of the floor: the shared period function (aura state length of srvdofunc 65, 66, 81 and 82, the first tick of an item aura, the immediate-aura guard), the aura and periodic skill timer (event type 8) and the item aura timer (event type 9). D2R 3.3, D2RLoader 1.3.1 image. If celestialrayone.aura-reactivation is installed it must be 1.0.5 or newer; older builds reject the changed item aura timer byte and switch their multi-aura fix off.

patches.description: Shared period function (0x434CC0): test the evaluated perdelay against 0 instead of 5. cmp eax,r8d becomes test eax,eax plus nop, so r8d keeps 5 only when perdelay is 0 or negative. Used for the aura state length of srvdofunc 65, 66, 81 and 82, the first tick of an item aura and the immediate-aura guard.

Aura and periodic skill timer (0x43B2B0, event type 8): cmp eax,edi becomes test eax,eax, so edi keeps 5 only when perdelay is 0 or negative. Arms and re-arms every learned, selected or monster aura and every periodic skill.
Item aura timer (0x437230, event type 9): cmp eax,ebx becomes test eax,eax, so ebx keeps 5 only when perdelay is 0 or negative. Re-arms every item_aura after each tick (gear, charms, monprop auras).
